title: Implement serial and parallel matrix crossfade
description:
Create Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.cpp only (Wave 2). Implement the API declared in Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h.

Requirements:
- prepareToPlay/prepare path: size/pre-allocate all scratch buffers for parallel path to samplesPerBlock x channel count; reset juce::SmoothedValue for PARALLEL_BLEND; never allocate inside process().
- process path real-time-safe: no heap allocation, no locks, prefer ScopedNoDenormals at the entry if consistent with sibling modules.
- ROUTING_MODE Serial Maximizer -> Exciter: S_E(S_M(x)).
- ROUTING_MODE Serial Exciter -> Maximizer: S_M(S_E(x)).
- ROUTING_MODE Parallel Matrix Blend: y = (1-K)*S_M(x) + K*S_E(x) where K is PARALLEL_BLEND advanced via SmoothedValue each sample or block-consistent smoothing to avoid clicks; use pre-sized scratch for intermediate S_M/S_E outputs.
- Engine owns module call order and crossfade summing only; do not reimplement Maximizer/Exciter internals.
- Runtime mode/blend changes must not reallocate; only retarget smoothing / branch selection.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h (from d.1)
- Source/DSP Maximizer and Exciter .h/.cpp prepare/process contracts
- Sibling DSP .cpp files for RT-safety and buffer handling patterns

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.cpp.
acceptance_criteria: Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.cpp exists and implements RoutingEngine prepare and process
Serial Maximizer->Exciter and Serial Exciter->Maximizer paths call modules in the correct order
Parallel path implements y = (1-K)*S_M(x) + K*S_E(x) with K from juce::SmoothedValue PARALLEL_BLEND and pre-allocated scratch buffers
process() performs no heap allocation and no locking
cmake -B cmake-build-debug -G Ninja configures successfully when run from project root
cppcheck --enable=all Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.cpp Source/DSP/RoutingEngine.h completes without error exit
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify Maximizer or Exciter module files
use mutexes or blocking locks on the audio path

allowed: implement three routing modes per header contract
use scratch buffers only sized in prepare
forbidden: change header public API beyond what d.1 already allows without editing the header (do not edit header)
introduce FFT or new DSP stages inside the router
wire parameters in PluginProcessor in this task
